text.title: Continuous Discovery Failure Modes
text.summary: Antipatterns observed in real deployments of Continuous Discovery. Each ties a symptom to a root cause and a concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Weekly interview slot collapses by week 4 because recruiting was ad-hoc.
antipattern.fix: Stand up in-app prompt + Userinterviews panel + scheduled recruiter agent before week 1.

antipattern.symptom: Agent declares 'insight' from <5 interviews without cross-tag. LLMs inventing "insights" from thin signal without enforcing the N>=5 rule in the schema.
antipattern.root-cause: Schema did not enforce N>=5. Reject completions that violate N>=5. Schema enforcement is the only reliable guard — prompt instructions alone are insufficient for this rule.
antipattern.fix: Reject completions violating N>=5 across >=2 sources; enforce in JSON Schema.

antipattern.symptom: Opportunities accumulate; monthly archival skipped; OST has 80+ nodes.
antipattern.fix: Mandatory monthly kill list; archive parked opportunities to archived-opportunities.md.

antipattern.symptom: Synthesizer conflates interviewer prompts with user statements.
antipattern.fix: Strip interviewer turns from transcript before synthesis; only user turns feed the synthesizer.

antipattern.symptom: Concurrent watcher runs overwrite insight-log.md. Daily Haiku watchers overwriting the insight log instead of appending atomically.
antipattern.root-cause: Author used Write instead of atomic append + lock. Use atomic append + lock file, never Write. Concurrent watcher runs without locking corrupt the log and lose the audit trail.
antipattern.fix: Use atomic append + lock file; never Write the log.

antipattern.symptom: Assumption-tester proposing "ship and measure" as a valid test type.
antipattern.root-cause: That is delivery, not discovery. Constrain allowed test types: smoke test, fake door, prototype, Wizard of Oz, concierge, Mom Test interview, data dive.
antipattern.fix: Enumerate the allowed test types in the assumption-tester prompt; step 3 of `content/04-procedure.xml` rejects 'ship and measure'.

antipattern.symptom: Bi-weekly synthesizer receiving full week's raw context exceeding the context window.
antipattern.root-cause: Pre-summarize per-day outputs with Haiku, feed the summaries to Opus. Full-week raw context overflows and silently truncates, losing the later days.
antipattern.fix: Daily Haiku summaries are the synthesizer's input, never raw logs; assert every day of the window is represented before the Opus run.

antipattern.symptom: Subagents writing to Dovetail/Notion via API creating duplicate notes on retry.
antipattern.root-cause: Require idempotency keys (hash of source URL + date) for all API writes. Retries without idempotency keys multiply notes and pollute the repository.
antipattern.fix: Every API write carries an idempotency key hashed from source URL + date; the receiver rejects duplicates.
